carbon-app/carbon

Authors: Mike Fix (@mfix22), Brian Dennis (@briandennis), Jake Dexheimer (@jakedex)

This GifOS app is a sandbox port of carbon.now.sh, not a vendor of the
Next.js / CodeMirror tree (that stack will not run in an opaque-origin
srcdoc with no network). What is taken from upstream:

  lib/constants.js  THEMES, DEFAULT_CODE, DEFAULT_SETTINGS, COLORS
  components/svg/Controls.js  traffic-light / B&W / sharp window chrome

Syntax colours are those THEMES, applied by a small in-tree tokenizer
(vendor/syntax.js) that maps onto Carbon's highlight keys (keyword,
string, comment, number, definition, property, …). Nothing is fetched
at runtime.

The MIT notice travels as COPYING-carbon.txt and is packed into the GIF.
